insertion_failure_classify — DRIVE pegfail op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.insertion_failure_classify(signature, table=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegfail; pegfail.insertion_failure_classify(signature, table=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("insertion_failure_classify"))

Usage

Looks up a signature in the table (fail-closed): if exactly 1 row matches, its class and recovery; if 0, "unknown" (no guessing); if 2 or more, ValueError as a table defect (cannot happen with a table that passed insertion_failure_validate).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

署名の欄に語彙の外の値があれば ValueError(綴り壊し)。返り: cls、recovery、row(当たった行の添字、無ければ −1)、n_match、basis。
